title: Taurus doesn't say it. Taurus bakes.
caption: Taurus says I love you with a cookie, then a sandwich, then a whole pie. Everyone feels it. This week, try saying it out loud once too. Actions matter, and so do words. Send this to the Taurus who shows up with snacks.
